`★ Insight ─────────────────────────────────────`
A token file can look complete while still being flat: `--color-accent: #d4af37` is a named hex, not a system. Material 3 / Polaris / Carbon keep a primitive ramp (gold-100…900), point semantic roles at it, then let components read the roles — that is what makes a theme swappable. Omnipus bound the name to the hex, so every new surface (calendar chips, mermaid, Tailwind `red-400`) invented another hex instead of extending the ramp.
`─────────────────────────────────────────────────`

## Maturity verdict: 3 (defined)

The SPA has a real Tailwind v4 `@theme` in `/Users/danielpiatkowski/AI-Agent-Workspace/omnipus/wt-release-session/src/styles/globals.css`. The five brand colours and three brand fonts match “The Sovereign Deep.” Dark is the structural default (`body` paints Deep Space Black / Liquid Silver). Button, card, and input consume those tokens.

It is **gappy**, not managed. Colour is a flat hex list, not primitive → semantic → component. Type, radius, shadow, and motion are almost untokenized. The calendar paints “in progress” sky-blue while the board paints it Forge Gold. **616** `text-[Npx]` classes sit below the 12px floor.

Report: `/Users/danielpiatkowski/AI-Agent-Workspace/omnipus/wt-release-session/docs/internal/ui-audit-2026-09-17/lane-a-tokens.md`

### Drift (production, tests excluded)

| Kind | Count | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Quoted hex | 125 in 12 files | Mermaid ~60; calendar/status/plan/avatar/file-type maps |
| `text-[Npx]` | 666 in 153 files | 364×10px, 211×11px, 39×9px, plus 8px and 7px |
| Below 12px | 616 | Visual-system floor |
| Tailwind default `text-red/amber/blue-…` | 78 in 32 files | Parallel palette next to brand tokens |
| `font-inter` / `font-outfit` / `--color-text-secondary` | used, not defined | Dead names |

## Top 3 fixes

1. **One status colour, owned by CSS.** Drive calendar chips from the same Forge Gold as the board; stop copying hex into TypeScript for alpha suffixes (`color-mix` instead).
2. **Tokenise type and enforce 12px.** Closed scale (brand H1 48 / body 16 / caption 12); lint-ban `text-[Npx]` below 12; resolve 14px root vs 16px brand.
3. **Finish the layers `@theme` started.** Primitive ramps; aliases for `--font-sans` / `--color-text-secondary`; gold-alpha, radius, shadow, duration; ban Tailwind `red-*`/`amber-*` in chrome.

`★ Insight ─────────────────────────────────────`
The 14px root vs 16px brand body is easy to miss: Settings stores `font_size` default 14, and `html` falls back to the same 14. Every `rem` in the app is 12.5% smaller than the brand sheet, so “caption 12px” in the guidelines is already denser on screen than intended — which is how 10px/9px then feels like the next step down rather than a floor violation.
`─────────────────────────────────────────────────`
